verdict.rationale: Docs show off-cycle payrolls exist specifically to handle 'corrections' and that upcoming payrolls can be queried by processing_statuses=unprocessed, implying payrolls remain editable before processing, but there is no explicit endpoint or workflow documented for canceling/voiding a payroll that has already been submitted before pay-out. missing for 10: explicit cancel/void-payroll API or docs, confirmation that a submitted-but-unprocessed payroll can be pulled back, independent/hands-on verification of this correction flow.
